corpus_scope: loaded_index; completeness requires an externally verified expected count
api_warmup: none; API warm/cold state is unknown
query_total_scope: Outer wall time around search_full_corpus + enrich_reply; excludes imports, client construction, index/model loading, local warmup and file writes
retriever_load_note: Retriever.load includes one local dense encoder warmup; downloads may occur for absent weights. OS caches are not cleared.
local_warmup_note: First input question searched once without rewrite/generation, excluded from timings. Uses the same real index and reranker.
publication_note: Machine-specific index and query paths were normalized for publication; measured values and query result files are unchanged.
